# Import files
```{r}
df <- read.csv("Data/regional_integrated_dataset3.csv" )
```

#Data Transformations

```{r}
# 1) Binary transformation of bloom absence/presence
bloom_threshold <- mean(df$Chlorophyll,na.rm=T) + sd(df$Chlorophyll,na.rm=T)
  
df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(bloom = case_when(Chlorophyll > bloom_threshold ~ 1,
                           .default = 0))

paste0("Number of blooms = ", sum(df2$bloom))

# 2) other parameter transformations?
```

# Model - Temperature (just to test)
```{r}
bigam <- glm(bloom~lagTemperature,family="binomial",data=df2)
summary(bigam)
```
